title: plantago major subsp. sinuata
intro: Plantago major subsp. sinuata, commonly known as buckthorn or lance-leaved plantain, is a subspecies of the greater plantain, a perennial herb native to Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine to support respiratory health, and its leaves have been employed to soothe digestive issues and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Plantago major subsp. sinuata include its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which have been attributed to its ability to relieve coughs, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and mucilages, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
